regime: Auditoria segregada executada sem atestação técnica de isolamento; sem implementação/mutantes produtivos ou selo de refinamento

inventory.read: step, skill, historical inventory methods/catalogs, current enumerator/product source, pinned binaries; no P1335 candidate matrix or selection

operator.read: frozen inputs, sources, outputs and historical methods
operator.write: p1335 provenance, runners, matrices, supplements, gates, final report and closure

classifier.read: step, history, source/full relevant L0, frozen catalog and public outputs

reviewer.write: p1335-review-* only; no edits to judged inputs

policy.unknown: mandatory Unknown or instability blocks closure/selection; report valid partial findings
policy.outputs: new p1335-* diagnostics and exclusive temporaries
policy.observables: public lookup/kind/repr and full exit/stdout/stderr; functional and transversal projections separate from inventory denominator
policy.budget: Two focal revisions without discriminatory gain require method review; run each full order once per validated runner; bounded command timeout 2700s; no unbounded retries or weakening Unknown
